notes:
Say it like this.

Long-press the words being read aloud and teach the voice how a name should sound. Break it into syllables with spaces — “Jin Woo” rather than “Jin-woo”, which is what actually works — and it will say it that way for the whole series. The page keeps its own spelling; only the sound changes.

That completes the set. Tap the words to fix what the page SAYS, long-press them to fix how it SOUNDS, and tap a name to say WHO is speaking.
